notes.title: Update v1.001
notes.content:
Bug fixes and refinements
1. Collision of obstructions refined
2. Token number bug fixed
3. Enter button bug fixed
4. Keyboard navigation improved
5. Controller and keyboard switching refined
6. Potential save data bug fixed
7. Save file backup added 
8. Remaining bridge tile count bug fixed
